title_zh: 新人把便装日穿成了睡衣日
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (17/20): The New Hire Who Turned Casual Day into Pajama Day
note_en: The pattern 把 A 理解成 B means "to take A to mean B": 小婷把“便装”理解成了“随便穿” "Xiao Ting took 'casual clothes' to mean 'wear whatever.'" The joke rests on 便 and 随便: 便装 is "casual wear," while 随便 means "anything goes." English has to explain the misunderstanding, but in Chinese the shared character makes the mix-up feel natural.
